title: The trick to cutting your Claude Code token usage! #ai #claude #claudecode #aihacks #fyp
description: Stop hitting rate limits in CloudCode 👀 Use /model opus plan to plan with Opus, then build with Sonnet. Don’t forget to turn on /plan mode too. Comment “help” if you want my full setup guide, and follow for more daily AI + CloudCode tips.
transcript: Are you sick of hitting your rate limits in Claude code? I'm going to show you one quick way to make sure you almost never see this again. Cuz this is a mistake most people make. If you're on a pro plan, you really need to listen up. So inside Claude code, you're going to hit {slash} model and write Opus plan. So this uses the best and most expensive model Opus for planning, but then Sonnet for building. But you're not done yet. And if you're just getting started with Claude code and want my video guide of how to set the whole thing up, just drop help in the comments below. Now make sure to type {slash} plan to actually put it into plan mode. You'll know you did it right because you'll see plan mode enabled. And don't forget to give me a follow for more daily AI and Claude code tips just like this.
